metadata.title: Mod Era British Pop Vinyl Aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s graphic layout featuring a repeating grid of stylized Union Jack flags with a cutout rectangular window for a portrait and a bold, blocky typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Repeating flag pattern as a structural frame
Solid blue rectangular blocks containing text and portraiture
High-contrast yellow display type against dark blue backgrounds
Grainy, high-contrast photographic portrait integrated into the grid
coreInvariants: Hand-stamped or screen-printed texture on flags
Primary color palette of red, white, blue, and yellow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait located in the lower-right quadrant, occupying approximately one-quarter of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow block-lettering spanning the upper-middle section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text block, moves across the large yellow title, and settles on the portrait in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with patterns and text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Navy Blue (background blocks and flag elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast between the yellow text and dark blue backgrounds.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Square outer corners with slightly rounded inner junctions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower case 'a' and 'e' have very small apertures
Ascenders and descenders are kept extremely short to maintain block shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast between heavy display type and light metadata type.

preserve: The blocky, square nature of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, vertical weight of the display text.
Provides the necessary thickness and 60s feel.
Matches the square, geometric aesthetic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a grid of stylized Union Jack flags with a hand-stamped, slightly distressed texture. Leave two solid navy blue rectangular areas: one in the top-left corner and one larger one in the middle-right. In the middle-right blue block, place a high-contrast, grainy photographic portrait of a person with a 1960s hairstyle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold, square yellow sans-serif text in the center-left, spanning across the middle. Add small, all-caps white geometric sans-serif text in the top-left blue block.

verificationChecks: Is the main text ultra-bold and yellow?
Are the flags arranged in a repeating grid?
Is the portrait high-contrast and grainy?
Is the color palette limited to red, white, blue, and yellow?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress/texture on the flags
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern fonts are used.
Check that the flag pattern feels hand-made rather than perfectly digital.
Verify the yellow text is the most prominent visual element.
Confirm the portrait is integrated into the grid structure.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a repeating national motif grid with solid color blocks for high-contrast, ultra-bold typography and a grainy halftone portrait.
